metadata.title: Measure of Maximal Entropy for Geodesic Flows on Noncompact Manifolds of Nonpositive Curvature
metadata.abstract: We establish the variational characterization of the measure of maximal entropy on noncompact manifolds of nonpositive sectional curvature. Assuming that the deck transformation group contains an axial isometry with a rank-one axis and has a finite critical exponent, we prove that the supremum of the entropies of invariant probabilities equals the critical exponent and is attained if and only if the Bowen-Margulis-Sullivan (BMS) measure is finite. In that case, the measure of maximal entropy is unique and equals the normalized BMS measure. The proof combines conditional-entropy rigidity on the regular set with an HTS-based entropy exclusion on the singular set, overcoming both non-compactness and the loss of uniform hyperbolicity due to zero curvature. We also obtain mixing under a non-arithmetic length-spectrum assumption. For nonpositively curved surfaces of genus at least two, the existence of a closed Jacobi rank-one geodesic and the non-arithmeticity of the axial length spectrum are automatic.

analysis.progressType: 非紧非正曲率测地流的熵刚性
analysis.workSummary: 在非紧非正截面曲率流形上，假设甲板变换群含有具有 rank-one 轴的轴向等距变换，且临界指数有限，证明不变概率测度熵的上确界等于临界指数，并且当且仅当 Bowen–Margulis–Sullivan（BMS）测度有限时取到。有限时最大熵测度唯一，等于归一化 BMS 测度；另在轴向长度谱非算术条件下得到混合性。
techniques: 正则集上的条件熵刚性
奇异集上的 HTS 型熵排除
rank-one 轴与 BMS 测度
analysis.breakthrough: 同时处理非紧性及零曲率造成的非一致双曲性，将熵变分原理、最大测度存在性与唯一性精确联系到 BMS 有限性。
analysis.limitations: 上确界可存在而不被概率测度取到；混合性另需非算术条件。亏格至少二的非正曲率曲面中闭 Jacobi rank-one 测地线与相应长度谱非算术性自动成立，不代表任意维流形自动满足。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。实际 PDF SHA-256 核对一致，40 页完整提取、无短文本页。第 39 页 Claude 命中均为参考文献作者 Jean-Claude Picaud 姓名，不是模型或作者工具使用；标准与补充检索未见自身 AI 使用披露。

analysis.priorityReason: 非正曲率几何、rank-one 动力系统及测度刚性紧密相关，应重点阅读非紧与平坦方向的控制。
